chapter.scpzone19.1.title: Shift Change
chapter.scpzone19.1.subtitle: 06:00 · Light Containment Zone
chapter.scpzone19.1.desc: Your first shift at Site-19. Commander Harris meets the new security recruits. The job is simple: draw your gear and take your post at the LCZ checkpoint. Simple shifts don't exist here, though.
chapter.scpzone19.2.title: Code Red
chapter.scpzone19.2.subtitle: 06:41 · Containment breach
chapter.scpzone19.2.desc: Sirens. Lockdown kicked in, every LCZ door is jammed and half the posts went dark. Reach the control room and restart the door system by hand.
chapter.scpzone19.3.title: The Dead Don't Sleep
chapter.scpzone19.3.subtitle: 07:15 · Heavy Containment Zone
chapter.scpzone19.3.desc: SCP-049 left its cell and "cured" the Heavy Containment staff. Its patients are walking the halls. Clear a path to the medbay, where Dr. Vance is hiding.
chapter.scpzone19.4.title: Don't Blink
chapter.scpzone19.4.subtitle: 08:02 · Office block
chapter.scpzone19.4.desc: SCP-173 is loose. It can't be killed, but it can be locked away: three emergency terminals will pull it back into its cell. While someone watches it, it can't move. Never blink at the same time.
chapter.scpzone19.5.title: The Old Man
chapter.scpzone19.5.subtitle: 09:30 · Generator sector
chapter.scpzone19.5.desc: Power failure in sector G, and something is walking through the walls. SCP-106. Start the backup generators and run the recontainment protocol. That one.
chapter.scpzone19.6.title: Gate B
chapter.scpzone19.6.subtitle: 10:12 · Evacuation
chapter.scpzone19.6.desc: MTF Epsilon-11 has entered the facility. All surviving personnel to Gate B. The level 5 card is in the O5 office safe. And SCP-096 is sitting in the corridor by the gate.
obj.scpzone19.c1.armory: Go to the armory down the corridor
obj.scpzone19.c1.checkpoint: Take your post at the LCZ checkpoint (L2 card)

obj.scpzone19.c3.kill: Neutralize SCP-049-2 instances in Heavy Containment
obj.scpzone19.c3.medbay: Find Dr. Vance in the medbay
obj.scpzone19.c3.cabinet: Take supplies from the medical cabinet
obj.scpzone19.c4.terminals: Activate the recontainment terminals in the office block
obj.scpzone19.c6.safe: Take the L5 card from the O5 office safe
obj.scpzone19.c6.gate: Break through to Gate B. Do not look at SCP-096
dlg.scpzone19.c1.i1: Morning, rookies. Welcome to Site-19. I'm Commander Harris, and as of now you're shift Beta.
dlg.scpzone19.c1.i2: Rule one: no unnecessary questions. Rule two: never look into the eyes of whatever sits behind the glass.
dlg.scpzone19.c1.i3: Armory is down the corridor. Draw your gear, then report to the LCZ checkpoint. Move.
dlg.scpzone19.c1.kit: USP, ammo, a level two card and a radio. If you ever have to shoot, it already went wrong.
dlg.scpzone19.c1.o1: Good. Hold the post, eyes open. Twelve hours. Nothing to it...
dlg.scpzone19.c2.i1: Attention all personnel. Containment breach detected. Lockdown protocol engaged.
dlg.scpzone19.c2.i2: Damn it! Every door in Light Containment is jammed. Get to the control room and restart the system manually!
dlg.scpzone19.c2.s1: You're in? Good. Console's by the far wall. Hit restart, I'm holding the line.
dlg.scpzone19.c2.o1: Restart confirmed! Doors are responding. Bringing the cameras up...
dlg.scpzone19.c2.o2: Camera 173... it's empty. Repeat: SCP-173's cell is empty. And something is moving in Heavy Containment.
dlg.scpzone19.c2.o3: Sending you remote level three clearance. Stick together.
dlg.scpzone19.c3.i1: Heavy Containment, corridor B... those aren't ours. They used to be ours. SCP-049 is out.
dlg.scpzone19.c3.i2: Its "patients" don't feel pain. Aim for the head and don't let them close. Clear that corridor!
dlg.scpzone19.c3.s1: Corridor's clear. Lin picked up a signal from the medbay. Someone's alive in there.
dlg.scpzone19.c3.s2: Security? Thank god... I'm Dr. Vance. There's SCP-500 in the cabinet and whatever's left. Take it, you need it more.
dlg.scpzone19.c3.o1: Listen. I saw the logs. 173 is in the office block. It can be put back. I'll talk you through it.
dlg.scpzone19.c3.o2: Vance stays on comms with us. Grab a P90, time to bring a bigger gun.
dlg.scpzone19.c4.i1: Attention. SCP-173 detected in the Light Containment office block. All personnel evacuate the sector.
dlg.scpzone19.c4.i2: It can't be killed. But three emergency terminals generate a field that drags it back into its cell.
dlg.scpzone19.c4.i3: And for god's sake, don't all blink at once. As long as one of you is looking at it, it can't move.
dlg.scpzone19.c4.s1: Containment field active. Check SCP-173's cell.
dlg.scpzone19.c4.o2: Clean work. Here's a level four card. It gets worse: we lost power in sector G.
dlg.scpzone19.c5.i1: Voltage drop in the generator sector... wait. The thermal camera shows something walking through a wall. SCP-106!
dlg.scpzone19.c5.i2: Bullets won't kill it, but they'll make it back off. Start both backup generators.
dlg.scpzone19.c5.i3: Then the Femur Breaker protocol in 106's chamber. Yes, I know how it sounds. Just press the button.
dlg.scpzone19.c5.s1: Power's back! 106's chamber is live. The protocol console is behind the glass.
dlg.scpzone19.c5.o1: ...I'll hear that scream for the rest of my life. But it worked. The old man is back in his cell.
dlg.scpzone19.c6.i1: Mobile Task Force Epsilon-11 has entered the facility. All surviving personnel proceed to Gate B.
dlg.scpzone19.c6.i2: Last push. The level five card is in the O5 office safe, I already sent you the code.
dlg.scpzone19.c6.i3: And listen carefully: SCP-096 is sitting in the corridor by the gate. Do not look at its face. Under any circumstances.
dlg.scpzone19.c6.s1: You've got the card. Now quietly, along the wall, eyes on the floor, to the gate.
dlg.scpzone19.c6.o1: Epsilon-11 to survivors: lower your weapons, you're under Foundation protection. Good work, security.
dlg.scpzone19.c6.o2: Shift's over. Site-19 is back under control. Mostly.
dlg.scpzone19.c6.o3: Get some rest, rookies. Six sharp tomorrow. Don't be late.
dlg.scpzone19.radio.finished: Shift closed. Stay in the facility or leave with /zone19 leave.
dlg.scpzone19.radio.static: ...kssh... no signal... return to Zone-19 (/zone19 enter)...

skin.scpzone19.guard_standard.desc: Standard security uniform: smoked visor helmet, vest, USP in the holster.
skin.scpzone19.guard_senior.desc: Peaked cap, tie and a red armband. Knows every LCZ corridor.
skin.scpzone19.guard_heavy.desc: Gas mask, armor plates and no sense of humor. Guards the Heavy Containment cells.
skin.scpzone19.guard_night.desc: Beret, reflective stripes and a headlamp. Site-19 is quieter at night. And scarier.
skin.scpzone19.mtf_e11.desc: "Nine-Tailed Fox". NVG helmet, balaclava, plate carrier.
skin.scpzone19.scientist.desc: Lab coat and a badge. For the friend who will "just take a quick look".
skin.scpzone19.class_d.desc: Orange jumpsuit. For whoever volunteers to open doors first.
doc.scpzone19.173.name: SCP-173 "The Sculpture"
doc.scpzone19.173.short: A concrete statue that moves at great speed when nobody is looking.
doc.scpzone19.173.summary: Constructed from concrete and rebar with traces of Krylon spray paint. It cannot move while in a direct line of sight. Once contact is broken it attacks by snapping the neck. Personnel may only enter in groups of three or more, keeping constant eye contact and announcing every blink.
doc.scpzone19.096.name: SCP-096 "The Shy Guy"
doc.scpzone19.096.short: A gaunt ~2.4 m humanoid. Enraged when anyone sees its face.
doc.scpzone19.096.summary: At rest it sits with its hands over its face, sobbing. Anyone who views its face, live, on video or in a photo, becomes its target. After a minute of screaming it runs to the target through any obstacle and destroys it. It cannot be stopped. Advice: do not look.
doc.scpzone19.106.name: SCP-106 "The Old Man"
doc.scpzone19.106.short: An elderly humanoid that corrodes any matter. Walks through walls.
doc.scpzone19.106.summary: Passes through solid material leaving black corrosive slime. Hunts personnel, dragging victims into its pocket dimension. Gunfire makes it retreat temporarily. Recontainment requires bait: the Femur Breaker protocol.
doc.scpzone19.049.name: SCP-049 "The Plague Doctor"
doc.scpzone19.049.short: A humanoid resembling a medieval plague doctor. Believes it cures "the Pestilence".
doc.scpzone19.049.summary: SCP-049's touch is lethal. After its "surgery" the bodies rise as SCP-049-2: aggressive and feeling no pain. The object itself is polite and talkative. 049-2 instances die to standard weapons.
